Type: two-door bar cabinet
Use: storing drinks and dishes, sideboard surface; dining room, living room
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: pine wood, brushed metal pulls and leg caps
Colors: warm honey wood, silver
Shape: tall rectangular case, two flat doors with tab pulls, open frame base with stretchers and metal-capped legs, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, simple, clean
Goes with: white walls, light textiles, black or brass accents; mid-century or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Pine Bar Cabinet, 31.5"W, Brown
product.description: This mid-century-style 2-door bar cabinet offers an understated but classic way to store your kitchen and bar supplies. It can easily fit in your kitchen or dining room, reducing clutter while adding a simple elegance. 31.5"W x 15.8"D x 39.4"H Pine and MDF with pine veneer This cabinet offers storage for your kitchen, bar, or dining room, with interior shelving for ample storage space. This bar cabinet sports a classic mid-century design that allows it to fit in any kitchen or dining room. Assemble in 15-30 minutes Using a soft, damp cloth, wipe in the direction of the grain. Free returns for 30 days; 1-year warranty.
